faq.q: How is a titanium sintered filter element manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium sintered filter element is manufactured using Powder sintering; CNC machining; Sheet fabrication; TIG welding. BOZE CNC Ti uses precision CNC equipment with strict process controls to ensure consistent quality and dimensional accuracy.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Grade 2 CP-Ti for titanium sintered filter element?
faq.a: Alternative materials include stainless steel (heavier, susceptible to corrosion) and aluminum (lower strength, shorter fatigue life). The alternative manufacturing method is Laser welding (higher capital cost, limited wall thickness capability).

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium sintered filter element?
faq.a: Titanium Sintered Filter Element components are typically manufactured to ASTM B348, ASME. Additional customer-specific specifications may apply.

faq.q: What are common failure modes for titanium sintered filter element?
